name: Knowtorious
summary: Knowtorious is a browser-based live trivia gameshow designed for in-person game nights. One player hosts from a shared screen while teams compete across a category board drawn from more than 400 categories and endless questions covering anime, film, tv shows, sports, gaming, music, geography, science, general knowledge and much more. The game features five modes: a classic category board, a heist mode with vault and alarm mechanics, a wagering mode with per-question bets, a carnival mode with traps and multipliers, and hex board game style mode. Matches are played by groups in the same room, with the host reading questions aloud and awarding points. The first match is free; later matches are played with in-game tickets.
